title: HSQC2STRUC: A Machine Learning Model for Protein Secondary Structure Prediction using Unassigned NMR Spectra
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习从未归属NMR谱预测蛋白质二级结构含量，虽涉及无序蛋白动态结构，但无PPI互作机制且方法为简单ML，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Dynamic changes in the secondary structure content of proteins can provide valuable insights into protein function or dysfunction. Predicting these dynamic changes is still a significant challenge but is of paramount importance for basic research as well as drug development. Here, we present a machine learning-based model that predicts the secondary structure content of proteins based on their un assigned 1 H, 15 N-HSQC NMR spectra with an RMSE of 0.11 for α -helix, 0.08 for β -sheet and 0.12 for random coil content. Our model has been implemented into an easy-to-use and publicly available web service that estimates secondary structure content based on a provided peak list. Furthermore, a Python version is provided, ready to be integrated into Bruker’s TopSpin software or own scripts.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质二级结构含量的动态变化可为蛋白质功能或功能障碍提供有价值的见解。预测这些动态变化仍是一项重大挑战，但对于基础研究以及药物开发至关重要。在此，我们提出一种基于机器学习的模型，该模型根据未分配的¹H, ¹⁵N-HSQC NMR谱预测蛋白质的二级结构含量，其α-螺旋的均方根误差（RMSE）为0.11，β-折叠为0.08，无规卷曲含量为0.12。我们的模型已实现为一个易于使用且公开可用的网络服务，该服务基于提供的峰列表估算二级结构含量。此外，还提供了一个Python版本，可随时集成到Bruker的TopSpin软件或用户自己的脚本中。
